system.description: Cast upon a door or entryway of the thaumaturge's haven, this power creates a subtle auditory or visual alert that signals when an intruder breaches the portal. The nature of the signal is chosen by the thaumaturge and remains constant for the duration, though it can be changed between castings. The thaumaturge must be present in the haven for the alarm to function. This power lasts 24 hours.
